paragraphs: CivicReach builds technology meant to help nonprofits and governments serve more people and follow through so they get help. The software covers phone calls, intake, referrals, case management and outcomes reporting for social service agencies.

AI-powered agents respond to every contact that comes in. Coverage runs in English, Spanish and other languages, around the clock. The agents screen for eligibility across programs, identify needs and capture intake data in one place. Referrals match residents with the right program application, department or community partners. Automated follow-ups, appointment reminders and status updates keep people moving through the process. Real-time dashboards show community needs, service gaps, resolution rates and impact.

Counties, cities and community based organizations all use it, according to the site. For community action agencies, the company says it supports work across energy assistance, Head Start and housing services. It claims independently audited security controls and HIPAA compliance. The team is described as civic technologists with deep resumes in government and nonprofit service delivery.

quote.text: CivicReach helps agencies answer every call, every time — with empathy, accuracy, and accountability.
